material.acceptance_criteria: Natives reachable from Lua return a Lua error instead of panicking (no expect on table set from a native; index checks before sim calls), and web tick()/dispatch_action stay alive on a malformed mod call; a fault-injection style test covers one native with a bad argument.
material.description: rust/crates/mod-host/src/piccolo_host.rs:428-451 comment admits it; ~100 .expect("row"/"list"/"json list") sites in natives (e.g. :572-634, :661, :4051, :4058) and sim indexing run unguarded in the page. A single bad mod argument or unexpected state traps the wasm and the match ends with no error text.

material.subject: On the browser wasm a Rust panic in a mod native aborts the page: guard_native and guarded cannot catch under panic=abort
material.witness: ci-status c2ba9675dce22de2b1b2b91a30a63a6fca6a648e: ci run 40182314685 jobs workspace tests, wasm32 and wasip3 compile, native and wasm state hash agree, map export, wire, static all success
material.witness_plan: CI: mod-host test calls every game.* native with a nil, a huge integer and a NaN argument and asserts an Err, not a panic. Browser: dispatch_action with a bad arg returns error text and the page keeps ticking.
